title: Claude or ChatGPT posts an email into one approval queue, and the Owner sees its facts check beside the text before pasting it into Frequency Email Studio
description: On 2026-11-11 the Owner asked for stream S9 of the beta channels work order (the email approval queue) so that today's "see what's new" email, the member re-engagement series R1 to R3, the stall rescue note (S4) and the first win thank-you (S5) wait in one place with their facts check. A new flow, email-queue, ships off. POST /v1/flows/email-queue/drafts { asset, subject, preheader?, body, audience } with the Owner's token stores the email in $FW_HOME/flows/email-queue/drafts/<asset>.json on channel email as a template for a list (lead_id template:email-studio:<audience>), so approving it is refused and nothing reaches the outbox: the Owner pastes it into /admin/crm/marketing and sends it there. The facts check is the draft gate (FW-C-102: dashes, emoji, Midnight, numbers not in the facts sheet, a tagged Frequency link, length) plus the email rules: every frequencylocal.com link carries utm_source=email, utm_medium=email, a campaign from the config (founding or launch) and utm_content=<asset>; no link to a path that is not live yet (/launch, /for/, /start/host); no typed price; no date but January 31, 2027 (the beta end) and January 1, 2027 (opening day); an opt-out line unless the list's sender adds an unsubscribe footer; and only the config's opted-in lists, never all_contacts, imported_contacts or members. Numbers come from $FW_HOME/facts.json, or from the config's facts_fallback until Frequency serves the sheet. A draft that breaks a rule is stored gate_blocked with its reasons. The Inbox lists the queue under the DMs as Emails for Email Studio, naming the list, and the drafts inbox shows a Blocked state and a Facts check section with the reasons, the preheader and each link with its tags.
acceptance: The email-queue flow ships off with the email tags, the closed paths /launch, /for/ and /start/host, and no audience that did not opt in
A clean email is stored waiting_for_owner on channel email as a list template with a facts check that blocks nothing, and the drafts list shows that check

A dash, Midnight, a typed price, a date other than January 31 or January 1, 2027, a made-up count, a closed link, wrong tags, no link, a missing opt-out and a list that did not opt in each store the email gate_blocked naming the rule
Approving a queue email is refused and nothing reaches the outbox
No token answers 401, a bad asset or empty body 400, and another flow 404
